# freetypingtest.app

## About
freetypingtest.app is a free, browser-based typing speed test that measures words per minute (WPM), accuracy, and consistency. No login, no cloud, no tracking. Everything runs client-side.

## Features
- Typing test with real-time WPM and accuracy tracking
- Multiple test durations: 15s, 30s, 60s, 120s
- Multiple text modes: Common Words, Quotes, Code, Numbers, Custom
- Real-time character-by-character feedback
- WPM-over-time graph
- Personal best tracking and test history (last 50 tests)
- Dark mode support
- Sound effects (optional)
- Keyboard shortcuts: Tab+Enter to restart, Ctrl+Shift+S to toggle sound

## Technical
- Static HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no build step
- All data stored in localStorage
- Deployable on any static hosting (Vercel, Netlify, etc.)
- PWA with service worker for offline support

## URL
https://freetypingtest.app
